citations.short: Failure to comply with REMS Implementation System
citations.long: An application holder did not comply with the audit plan and schedule described in the REMS, as required by your approved REMS Implementation System.
Failure to ensure proper monitoring of the study and ensure the study is conducted in accordance with the protocol and/or investigational plan.
Failure to provide FDA with a written IND safety report.
Lack of records covering of an investigational drug.

citations.short: Notification of FDA of termination of investigator
citations.long: Failure to notify FDA of the ending, for cause, of an investigator's participation in an investigation.

citations.short: Authority lacking to review records, investigate errors
citations.long: The quality control unit lacks authority to fully investigate errors that have occurred.

Records are not maintained so that data therein can be reviewed at least annually to evaluate the quality standards of each drug product to determine the need for changes in specifications or manufacturing or control procedures.
All serious and unexpected adverse experiences were not reported within 15 calendar day of initial receipt of the information.

citations.short: Ensuring compliance with plan and protocol
citations.long: Failure to ensure that an investigation was conducted in accordance with the general investigational plan and protocols as specified in the IND.

citations.short: Defined areas of adequate size for operations
citations.long: The separate or defined areas and control systems necessary to prevent contamination or mix-ups are deficient.
Separate or defined areas to prevent contamination or mix-ups are deficient regarding operations related to aseptic processing of drug products.

citations.short: Validation lacking for sterile drug products
citations.long: Procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile do not include validation of the sterilization process.
Established laboratory control mechanisms are not followed and documented at the time of performance.
Written records are not made of investigations into unexplained discrepancies and the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet specifications.
Written records of investigations into the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet specifications do not always include the conclusions and follow-up.
